title: Study Explorer
no_file: Open a backup file first — pick one to browse.
detail_empty: Select an item from the list.
too_many: Showing first {n} of {total} — narrow the search.
err_corrupt: This file isn't a readable .jwlibrary backup — it may be corrupted or the wrong type of file.
err_no_db: This backup is missing its notes database (userData.db). Re-export it from JW Library.
err_not_sqlite: The backup's database couldn't be opened — the file may be damaged.
hl_no_text: Highlighted passage (text lives in the publication, not the backup).
delete_note_confirm: Delete this note? This cannot be undone.
delete_hl_confirm: Delete this highlight? This cannot be undone.
delete_bm_confirm: Delete this bookmark? This cannot be undone.
unsaved_exit: You have {n} unsaved edit(s). Close without exporting?
plain_text_note: Formatting simplified to plain text on save
rich_text_note: Edit with bold, italics and lists — formatting is kept
extract_none: No notes fall in this date range.
extract_hint: Save a new .jwlibrary with only the notes in this date range.
md_hint: Download the notes shown as Markdown files (.zip)
batch_delete_confirm: Delete {n}? You can Undo before exporting.
delete_if_confirm: Delete this study answer? You can Undo before exporting.
share_intro: This makes a file you hand over yourself — nothing is uploaded. It contains the note text, so share only with people you trust.
receive_intro: Paste shared text, or choose a .jwshare.json file someone sent you.
receive_invalid: That doesn't look like valid shared-notes data.
ask_sub: Search your notes by meaning, not just keywords — ask in plain language and find related notes even when they use different words. Runs entirely on your device.
ask_placeholder: e.g. notes about staying loyal under pressure
ask_enable_body: A small language model runs in your browser to understand your notes. It downloads once, is cached for offline use, and nothing ever leaves your device.
ask_model_fast_desc: 3-layer model — about 2× faster than English and half the download. Perfect for large libraries.
ask_model_en_desc: Standard accuracy for notes written in English.
ask_model_multi_desc: Understands 50+ languages — choose this if you write notes in more than one language.
ask_privacy: 100% private — the model and your notes never leave this device.
ask_no_results: No related notes found. Try rephrasing your question.
ask_no_notes: This library has no notes to search yet.
ask_err: Couldn't load the search model. Check your connection and try again.
